{{Quote|Attention, all officers and crews of the Coruscant Imperial Third Fleet. This is Admiral Kelsan. In the face of overwhelming enemy strength, I order you to lower your shields and surrender&hellip;|Peto Kelsan|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
'''Peto Kelsan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] who pledged loyalty to [[Darth Krayt]] when [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] was [[Attack on Emperor Fel|ousted]] from the throne by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in [[130 ABY]]. Holding the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], Kelsan was placed in command of the [[Coruscant Third Fleet]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[137 ABY]], Kelsan's command was stationed at [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] significant for its status as one of the great financial centers of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. That year, Ralltiir came under [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|attack]]; elements of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]&mdash;the previous galactic government, toppled by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and Roan Fel while they had been allies&mdash;engaged Kelsan's command. The Galactic Alliance forces, led by Admiral [[Gar Stazi]], were shortly thereafter reinforced by the [[Bastion Second Fleet]], commanded by [[Edouard Fenel]] of [[Fel Empire|Fel's Empire]].

Against the enemies' overwhelming numbers, Kelsan reluctantly surrendered the Coruscant Third [[Fleet/Legends|Fleet]] to Fenel. When [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vaclen Tor]] of the [[Ardent-class fast frigate|frigate]] [[Steadfast (Ardent-class)|''Steadfast'']] refused to comply and reminded Kelsan of their duty to prevent the fleet from falling into the hands of the enemy, the Admiral was placed in a moral quandary. Kelsan ultimately decided to ignore Fenel's subsequent order to open fire upon the ''Steadfast'' and directed the Third Fleet to initiate [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]] and flee in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] to Ralltiir. To Kelsan's surprise, Gar Stazi then ordered his forces to protect the Third Fleet as it was evacuated, in order to prevent Fenel from opening fire on the defenseless escape pods. Once the crews were clear, Kelsan thanked Stazi before initiating the self-destruct mechanisms on the [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. The Admiral remaining aboard the [[Avenger (Pellaeon-class)|''Avenger'']] and [[Death/Legends|died]] as the warship exploded over Ralltiir.

==Biography==
===Rise to admiral===
{{Quote|Admiral Kelsan&hellip;Peto. Been a long time. Made you admiral, did they?|Edouard Fenel|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
[[File:Kelsanduringbattle.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Admiral Peto Kelsan in the ''Avenger''{{'s}} command center]]
Peto Kelsan was a member of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Fel Empire|Empire]] and held a rank in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] was acquainted with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Edouard Fenel]].<ref name="Legacy 36" /> In [[127 ABY]],<ref name="Legacy 0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> Roan Fel and his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] allies, led by [[Darth Krayt]], initiated a [[Sith–Imperial War|war]] against the reigning government, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="Legacy 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> Upon the conclusion of the war in [[130 ABY]],<ref name="Legacy 0" /> Darth Krayt and his [[One Sith|Sith Order]] toppled the Galactic Alliance, turned on Emperor Fel, and [[Attack on Emperor Fel|attacked]] him. Fel fled the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], leaving [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt to take over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Legacy 1" /> In the resulting fallout, the Imperial Navy split among the two camps;<ref name="Legacy 0" /> Peto Kelsan was among those who pledged loyalty to Darth Krayt and was placed in command of the [[Coruscant Third Fleet]], holding the rank of admiral.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

Kelsan commanded the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the [[Avenger (Pellaeon-class)|''Avenger'']], a [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]], itself [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Furske]]. By [[137 ABY]], Kelsan's command had been assigned to protect [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], a strategically important [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] and one of the great financial centers of the galaxy. As the fleet provided Ralltiir with a strong defense, it seemed unlikely to the Imperials that the planet would be attacked, as neither Roan Fel nor the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] were deemed to have sufficient [[Warship/Legends|warships]].<ref name="Legacy 36" />

During the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], however, the [[Core Fleet|fleet]] of Galactic Alliance Remnant [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Gar Stazi]] emerged out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] directly in front of Kelsan's fleet and [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|engaged]] it at close quarters. The Coruscant Third Fleet was swamped by Stazi's forces, which targeted the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and defensive systems of Kelsan's warships in order to disable and capture them. As Kelsan's fleet powered up their [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and returned fire, the Admiral called for a report from Captain Furske, who reported that the ''Avenger''{{'s}} engines had sustained damage prior to the raising of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] shields. Aware that Krayt's forces had an advantage in firepower, Kelsan remained confused by Stazi's abrupt attack. The two fleets continued to trade salvoes until the reason behind Stazi's bold attack became clear&mdash;an [[Bastion Second Fleet|Imperial fleet]] aligned with Emperor Roan Fel emerged from hyperspace and pressed the attack alongside Stazi's forces.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

===Death over Ralltiir===
{{Quote|You did not go ''with'' your crews, Admiral Kelsan.''"<br />"''No. My place is on my ship. I'm sure you understand. I'm not certain why you're doing this, admiral&hellip;I don't think I would have done the same. But I thank you.|Gar Stazi and Peto Kelsan|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
The combined enemy fleets outnumbered Kelsan's command, and the ''Avenger'' suffered damage to its shields under the renewed assault. Kelsan was soon contacted directly by Admiral Edouard Fenel. Fenel acknowledged Kelsan's ascendancy to the rank of admiral before requesting a cease-fire so that he could address the Coruscant Third Fleet. Beaten, Kelsan acquiesced and ordered Fenel to be patched through to his command. Fenel issued an ultimatum for Kelsan's command to surrender within ten minutes or face total destruction, and he also used Fel's authority to order Kelsan's crews to eliminate their commanding officers if they refused to surrender.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

Kelsan regretfully announced that the fleet were to comply with Fenel's directives. To the surprise of both Kelsan and Fenel, however, one officer of the Coruscant Third Fleet&mdash;Captain [[Vaclen Tor]] of the [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] [[Steadfast (Ardent-class)|''Steadfast'']]&mdash;dissented. Over a general frequency, Tor announced that Kelsan's orders were unacceptable, stating that the Coruscant Third Fleet owed its loyalty to Emperor Krayt. The Captain personally addressed Kelsan with a reminder that it was their duty&mdash;and a matter of honor&mdash;to prevent the warships of the Third Fleet from falling into the hands of the enemy.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

[[File:Kelsandeath.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Admiral Kelsan dies during the self-destruction of the Coruscant Third Fleet.]]
Irate, Fenel first ordered Tor's crew to kill him and, when that failed, ordered his entire fleet to open fire on the ''Steadfast''. Already conflicted, Kelsan refused to fire upon the vessel despite Fenel's repeated orders. Kelsan chose to instead order the crews of the Third Fleet to disregard his previous order to surrender and to initiate the [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanisms]] on their warships, before evacuating in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] and fleeing to Ralltiir. The Admiral decided to remain upon ''Avenger'' to cover the evacuation and go down with the ship, but Fenel broadcast a subsequent order to open fire on the Third Fleet's escape pods. To Kelsan's surprise, Fenel was defied by Gar Stazi, who positioned his warships to protect the Third Fleet and refused to fire on the defenseless crews.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

Once Stazi's forces had taken up position and prevented Fenel's fleet from attacking, Stazi made personal contact to inform Kelsan that it was safe to begin the evacuation. The crews of the Third Fleet abandoned their vessels in droves; once all were clear, Kelsan initiated the fleet's self-destruct and informed the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] admiral. When Stazi asked why Kelsan had not entered an escape pod, but Kelsan's place was aboard ''Avenger''. The Admiral thanked Stazi as the Third Fleet warships began to detonate, perishing as ''Avenger'' was destroyed.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Admiral Kelsan, I gave an order for all Imperial ships to open fire on the ''Steadfast''. That includes ''your ships''!''"<br />"''We can't! The ''Steadfast'' is one of our own&hellip;!''"<br />"''It is not a ''request'', Kelsan! Do it!''"<br />"''No. All ships of the Third Coruscant Fleet. This is Admiral Kelsan. Disregard my previous order. You will set the self-destruct devices on your ships and then take the lifepods to Ralltiir&mdash;''Avenger'' will cover.|Admirals Edouard Fenel and Peto Kelsan|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
Peto Kelsan was a pragmatic individual. During the Battle of Ralltiir, the Admiral recognized that there were hidden reasons behind Stazi's bold attack. When outgunned and outnumbered by the enemy, Kelsan chose to surrender rather than fight a battle that could not be won. Kelsan could not imagine making the same decision as Stazi to defend an enemy as they fled a battle. When tested, however, the Admiral abandoned pragmatism and chose to stand by codes of honor and duty. Refusing to fire upon a warship under Kelsan's own command, Kelsan positioned the ''Avenger'' in harm's way to protect the evacuating crews. Rather than join in the retreat,<ref name="Legacy 36" />

==Behind the scenes==
Admiral Peto Kelsan appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 36|thirty-sixth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', ''Renegade'', published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and illustrated by [[Omar Francia]].<ref name="Legacy 36" />
